brief.subject: A hand holds an inoculating loop by its handle with the wire loop in a Bunsen burner flame, sterilising it before use.
mustShow: A hand holds the loop by its handle.
The wire loop is in the flame.
The flame comes from a laboratory burner.
brief.caption: Flaming the loop: the wire is held in the burner flame until it glows, which kills anything on it.
brief.alt: A hand holds the handle of an inoculating loop so that its thin wire end sits in the flame of a laboratory burner.
